status: partial prepared implementation; not versioned or published as 1.72
finding: The existing 100-unit per-packet discontinuity check did not bound total travel over time. Network samples could also supply airborne walking heights in instances.
implementation: Entity-local, transient walking allowance meters canonical horizontal distance divided by current server-derived speed against elapsed server time; at most two seconds of travel credit are retained, including initial credit.

Packet rate and legacy sequence zero cannot bypass the allowance. Recovery-context changes and trusted server repositioning neither reset nor spend it; a transport reconnect retains the same entity state.

Collision and casino-floor clamps precede charging actual displacement. Speed/discontinuity denials acknowledge fresh matching-context sequences with unchanged authoritative position; stale/context-invalid samples do not advance acknowledgements.

Finite float32-replicable coordinates/rotation are required before network geometry work. Walking preserves server-owned height or resolves overworld terrain rather than taking airborne height from client input.
Trusted internal movement retains its prior geometry/sequencing behavior. No production users, positions, saved stats, credentials or host settings were changed.

verification.client: GameEngineMovementSmoothness: 17 tests passed in 0.865 seconds, including unchanged-position speed rejection, pending-prediction retirement, duplicate acknowledgements and the next ordinary sample.
verification.lint: Repository ESLint passed with zero warnings.
verification.negativeCases: 180 same-clock samples cannot exceed the initial allowance, both ordered and legacy-zero variants; no travel with invalid speed; no clock-backward credit; stale/departed/nonfinite/non-replicable inputs preserve position/budget/ack; context changes and trusted repositioning do not mint credit; airborne walking height is ignored.
verification.positiveCases: 200 ordinary 100ms walking samples; two-second coalesced movement after long idle; server-derived haste and slow; stationary rotation; rock clipping, 391 saved tree-position escapes, approved town recovery, QA-waypoint handoff and Dark Realm movement-context reset.
verification.fixtureCorrections: Woodland and chat-only expedition fixtures now provide ordinary speed; the rock test starts within a valid walking allowance. Town recovery tests walk a small valid distance and use separate trusted setup for quest proximity. Client correction waits one ordinary 30Hz send interval; dispatch acknowledgements inspect the live entity rather than a detached copy that omits the field.

limits: Two seconds of lag credit permits a bounded burst; it is not frame-perfect movement or a PvP anti-cheat certification. Actual network reconnect/lag/haste routes still require connected verification.

Jump travel/range, jump height and cast authority remain separate unfinished boundaries. Dungeon wall-crossing geometry also requires review; endpoint clamping alone does not prove an entire path is walkable.

Existing connected QA helpers that rapidly send large movement waypoints must be updated to real walking or already-authorized fixture setup before publication; do not weaken the guard to preserve teleporting tests.

No new full campaign, capacity soak, production binary or deployment is claimed by this receipt. Ordered predecessors and the account-recovery ownership/delivery choice still precede 1.72 publication.
